title: Planscherel Measure on Eq(2)
abstract: Following the construction of the invariant integral and the scalar product for the quantum Euclidean group Eq(2), we obtained the full matrix elements of its unitary irreducible representations from SUq(2) by contraction and then derived the Planscherel measure.
